mainEntity.name: What are the common mistakes to avoid when implementing GEO for Service Pages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common mistakes include creating duplicate content across different location pages, often called 'doorway pages,' which search engines penalize. Another error is keyword stuffing—over-optimizing pages with too many geographic terms, making content unnatural. Not providing unique, valuable content for each location is also a pitfall, as generic pages offer little user benefit. Ignoring mobile optimization, failing to consistently update NAP information, and neglecting internal linking strategies for these pages can also hinder performance. Each page should offer genuine value to a local searcher.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid duplicate content, keyword stuffing, and generic pages when implementing GEO for Service Pages. Neglecting mobile optimization, NAP consistency, and internal linking are also common errors.
